subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this remain the umbrella tracker while narrower fixes land, or should maintainers split the remaining work into canonical narrower issues and close the umbrella afterward?
rationale: The report includes reproducible bugs, but the remaining fix shape crosses session-state repair and broader orchestration policy, which automation cannot choose permanently.

options.title: Keep umbrella plus narrow fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open for routing and review focused fixes such as the subagent delivery and lock-stall PRs before reassessing closure.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Promote one or more narrower canonical issues for session locks, detached child work, and orchestration semantics, then close this umbrella only after links preserve the evidence.

options.title: Sponsor redesign
options.body: Treat token-ring or metadata-only completion as a maintainer-led product design effort instead of a bug-sweep candidate.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella plus narrow fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for routing and review focused fixes such as the subagent delivery and lock-stall PRs before reassessing closure.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history signal across the relevant agent/session/config files and the broadest context for the orchestration boundary choice.
